title: 통일ㆍ북한 연구비 지급 규정 / queue:ADDENDUM:35838:20251104:00005:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDA (Decree on the Organization of the Ministry of Unification and Its Affiliated Agencies) <Presidential Decree No. 35838, Nov. 4, 2025>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

Article 2 Omitted.

Article 3 (Amendments to Other Statutes)
(1) and (2) Omitted.

(3) The Regulations on Payment of Research Expenses for Unification and North Korean Studies are partially amended as follows:

In Articles 1 and 2, "National Institute for Unification Education" is replaced with "National Institute for Peaceful Unification and Democratic Education", respectively.

In the first sentence of the part other than the subparagraphs of Article 4, Article 5 (1) and (2), Article 6, Article 7, and Article 8 (1), "President of the National Institute for Unification Education" is replaced with "President of the National Institute for Peaceful Unification and Democratic Education", respectively.
